title: Antarctic Ozone Hole Is the Seventh Largest in 48 Years
paragraphs: There is a big hole in the ozone layer over Antarctica. Ozone protects us from the sun. Scientists watch the hole every year.
In 2026, the hole was big. It was the seventh biggest in 48 years. The hole was widest on September 18.
The weather made the hole bigger this year. But people help too. They stopped using some bad chemicals. Scientists think the hole will close by the 2070s.
